newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: Armed gang springs prisoners in Colombia.
newsitem.headline: Armed gang springs prisoners in Colombia.

text.p: An armed gang held up a prison van and freed 38 convicts after a brief shoot-out in the northwest Colombian city of Medellin on Wednesday, officials said.
Five of the 17 prison guards travelling in the vehicle were injured in the attack.
Prison authorities said 22 escapees were recaptured almost immediately but 16 were still on the run several hours later.
The van was transporting the prisoners back to jail after court appearances. Most faced charges of murder, rebellion and assault, a spokesman for the National Prisons Institute (INPEC) said.
The spokesman said more than 20 men were involved in the attack, some travelling in an all-terrain truck and others on motorcycles.
Officials were investigating to determine whether they were leftist rebels or common criminals.
